verdict.rationale: Showing cardholders their own PAN/CVV without inheriting PCI scope is a fair question for a card-issuing platform like Lithic, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents hosted card-display components, ephemeral-key reveal flows, or PCI/SAQ D scope reduction. The pack covers only card creation, auth rules, webhooks, KYC and MCP.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
